body:
WHAT
The Windows installer (NSIS, an installer scripting system electron-builder uses) gets extra steps from app/build/installer.nsh. On install it copies bin\magentra.cmd into the install directory and appends '$INSTDIR\bin' to the user's (HKCU) PATH only if that exact text is not already there. On uninstall it deletes magentra.cmd and the bin folder and removes exactly its own PATH entry, handling the three forms it can be in: the whole PATH, ';$INSTDIR\bin' in the middle or end, or '$INSTDIR\bin;' at position 0. Both paths broadcast WM_WININICHANGE so open shells learn of the change. afterPack.js supplies the magentra-cli.exe the shim runs.

WHY
Without this the 'magentra' terminal command is not on PATH after install; an upgrade that appended blindly would grow PATH with duplicates; and a careless uninstall could delete or reorder other programs' PATH entries.

WHERE
app/build/installer.nsh — macro MAGENTRA_STRLOC (functions magentraStrLoc / un.magentraStrLoc, a substring finder), macro customInstall (CreateDirectory, File magentra.cmd, SetOutPath restore, ReadRegStr HKCU Environment Path, WriteRegExpandStr append, SendMessage HWND_BROADCAST WM_WININICHANGE), macro customUnInstall (Delete, RMDir, the three removal branches magentraUnMid / magentraUnLead / exact-match DeleteRegValue); app/scripts/afterPack.js — writeConsoleSubsystemCopy(srcExe, destExe) and the win32 branch of afterPack writing magentra-cli.exe; app/build/magentra.cmd — the shim itself; app/package.json build.nsis.include.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Port the PATH logic to a test harness (or run the built setup in a Windows VM): installing when HKCU\Environment\Path is 'C:\a;C:\b' yields 'C:\a;C:\b;<INSTDIR>\bin' and bin\magentra.cmd exists; installing again (upgrade) leaves PATH byte-identical with a single occurrence.
2. Installing when HKCU Path is empty or absent writes exactly '<INSTDIR>\bin' with no leading semicolon.
3. Uninstalling from 'C:\a;<INSTDIR>\bin;C:\c' yields 'C:\a;C:\c'; from '<INSTDIR>\bin;C:\c' (leading form) yields 'C:\c'; from exactly '<INSTDIR>\bin' deletes the Path value; and from 'C:\a;C:\b' (entry absent) leaves PATH unchanged and touches nothing.
4. The PE patcher writeConsoleSubsystemCopy on a fixture exe copies the file and changes only the 2-byte Subsystem field (offset e_lfanew+24+68) from 2 to 3; a fixture whose subsystem is neither 2 nor 3, or with no PE signature, throws and writes no output file.
5. Static checks on installer.nsh: the un. variant of magentraStrLoc is only inserted under !ifdef BUILD_UNINSTALLER and the plain one under !ifndef, both customInstall and customUnInstall end with SendMessage ${HWND_BROADCAST} ${WM_WININICHANGE}, and customInstall restores SetOutPath "$INSTDIR" after the File line.
